question: On which of the following occasions the lunar eclipse occurs?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Full moon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A lunar eclipse can happen only **when the moon is full**.
 
• A lunar eclipse **can be noticed from Earth at night.**
 
• There are two kinds of lunar eclipses:** total lunar eclipses** and **partial lunar eclipses. **
 
• A total lunar eclipse happens when the **moon and the sun are on exact opposite sides of Earth**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6923354d85ba45ecd69d6082d87d1d7dafec0c0c078c75139cddf443dd61449.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New moon happens when the moon is on the same side of Earth as the sun**.​
 
• The **Third or Last Quarter Moon** is also known a **Half Moon** because the Sun's rays illuminate just **50% of the Moon's surface.**** **
 
• **The moon is 90 degrees away from the sun in the sky and is half-illuminated from our point of view **is called first quadrature.
